description.en: SECOM’s Nangang headquarters was a single-tenant design & build fit-out. HQ Design planned and built six floors of workplace for SECOM, delivering more than 600 seats with phased, floor-by-floor construction so operations continued without disruption.
description.zh: 中興保全南港總部為單一業主設計施工統包專案。惠強負責六層辦公空間的整體規劃與施工，打造逾六百席的工作場域，並以分層分區排程推進，確保施工期間營運不中斷。

description.en: Office fit-out for C.SUN Industrial, a listed Taiwanese manufacturer. The design reflects the client's scale and brand while optimising executive-level spaces and overall circulation efficiency.
description.zh: 志聖工業辦公空間設計施工，為台灣上市製造企業打造符合企業規模與品牌形象的辦公環境，兼顧管理階層需求與整體動線效率。

name.zh: 中保科技展示廳 SECOM TECHNOLOGY HALL

description.en: Brand exhibition hall for SECOM Group. The space combines immersive experience design with smart security technology showcases, creating a flagship venue aligned with the group's corporate identity.
description.zh: 中保集團品牌展示廳設計施工專案，以沉浸式空間體驗呈現智慧安防技術與企業形象，融合科技感與品牌識別，打造符合企業定位的旗艦展示空間。

description.en: Interior fit-out for Kimpton Da An Hotel, Taipei. HQ delivered public area and corridor works, combining refined joinery with the brand's warm, design-led aesthetic.
description.zh: 台北大安 Kimpton Da An Hotel 國際飯店裝修工程，由惠強承攬公共區域與客房走廊施工，以精細木作與品牌美學呈現國際精品飯店水準。

description.en: Combined workspace for AIONTECH and Epicstech. The design prioritises open collaboration zones, brand-forward interiors and flexible layouts suited to fast-growing tech teams.
description.zh: 博訊科技與史詩科技聯合辦公空間，以開放協作為核心設計理念，融入品牌視覺語言，打造兼具靈活性與科技感的現代工作環境。

description.en: Office and disaster prevention command centre for Polytron-global. The dual-function space meets strict technical requirements for both everyday operations and emergency response.
description.zh: 保創科技辦公空間結合防災應變中心，以高規格的技術需求為設計依據，兼顧指揮功能與日常辦公使用，空間機能複合，施工精度要求嚴格。

description.en: 10th floor office renovation for Epicstech. Precision zoning and brand-aligned interiors deliver a high-performance workspace — completed without disrupting day-to-day operations.
description.zh: 史詩科技 10 樓辦公空間翻新專案，以精準的空間配置與品牌色系整合，打造高效能現代辦公環境，施工期間維持正常營運。

description.en: 11th floor fit-out for a cybersecurity firm. The design reflects the client's brand of precision and trust — clean lines, measured materiality and a workspace that communicates expertise.
description.zh: 保華資安 11 樓辦公空間設計施工，以資安產業的專業形象為設計出發點，融合穩重、精準的空間語彙，打造符合企業定位的工作環境。

description.en: 9th floor office fit-out for Xinlan Enterprise. The layout reflects the client's operational workflow, balancing open collaboration areas with focused workspaces.
description.zh: 欣蘭企業 9 樓辦公空間設計施工，依據客戶的業務特性與團隊動線需求，規劃兼具專業感與使用效率的現代辦公環境。

description.en: 9th floor office renovation for Liwei Electronics. Inspired by the precision of the electronics industry, the space projects technical expertise while supporting both R&D and business collaboration.
description.zh: 立偉電子 9 樓辦公室翻新，以電子產業的精密工藝為設計靈感，呈現技術導向企業的專業形象，動線規劃符合產品研發與業務協作需求。

description.en: 9th floor fit-out for Lijie International. The space balances a professional reception and meeting front-of-house with efficient back-office layouts, projecting the client's international business identity.
description.zh: 立捷國際 9 樓辦公空間，以國際商務形象為設計基調，空間配置兼顧接待洽談與內部辦公功能，呈現企業的專業與開放文化。

name.zh: 惠強室內裝修 HQ DESIGN & BUILD

description.en: HQ's own office and showroom, purpose-built to demonstrate 31+ Years of design-build craftsmanship. The space integrates working offices, client reception and material sample zones into one cohesive brand experience.
description.zh: 惠強室內裝修自建辦公室與材料展示空間，以 31 年設計施工積累的工藝能量為展示主軸，整合辦公、接待與材料樣品區，呈現品牌完整服務能力。

location.en: 9F, No. 135, Jingmao 2nd Road, Nangang District, Taipei
location.zh: 台北市南港區經貿二路135號9F

description.zh: 中保科技旗下中保保經 11 樓辦公空間設計施工，延續中保集團一貫的穩重專業形象，以精準工法打造符合金融保險產業定位的辦公環境。

description.en: 9th floor fit-out for Jingzhen Technology. Clean, contemporary lines support a high-efficiency workspace aligned with the tech sector's demands.
description.zh: 京琠科技 9 樓辦公空間設計施工，以科技產業的簡潔俐落為基調，呈現現代專業的工作場域氛圍。

description.en: 9th floor fit-out for Tianhe Telecom. The design balances open collaboration and focused work zones, reflecting the operational needs of a telecoms business.
description.zh: 天河電訊 9 樓辦公空間設計施工，以電信科技產業特性為設計出發，整合開放協作與獨立作業需求，打造高效能的現代辦公環境。

name.zh: 樂到家國際娛樂 LOTS HOME

description.en: 9th floor fit-out for an international entertainment company. The design brings brand personality and creative energy into a professional office framework.
description.zh: 樂到家國際娛樂 9 樓辦公空間設計施工，以娛樂產業的活潑創意為調性，在專業辦公格局中注入品牌個性與空間活力。

description.en: Interior fit-out for Chicken Up (起家雞) in Taichung. The Korean fried chicken brand's vibrant identity is expressed through bold finishes while maintaining efficient table turnover.
description.zh: 起家雞台中店餐飲空間設計施工，以韓式炸雞品牌風格為設計基調，呈現活潑品牌個性，並兼顧高效翻桌與舒適用餐體驗。

description.en: Flagship fit-out for The Soup Spoon at Taipei 101 mall. HQ delivered a brand-coherent dining environment within the high-profile landmark, balancing quality and speed.
description.zh: The Soup Spoon 台北 101 旗艦店設計施工，於台灣最高地標商場打造符合品牌質感的用餐環境，工程精度與施工速度並重。

description.zh: The Soup Spoon 台北車站店設計施工，位於高人流交通樞紐，空間規劃強調快速翻桌動線與視覺識別，同時符合車站商場施工規範。

description.en: Interior fit-out for Popeyes Xuchang Street, Taipei. The design captures the brand's American identity while maximising throughput with an efficient circulation plan.
description.zh: 大力水手 許昌店餐飲空間設計施工，以美式炸雞品牌識別為核心，規劃符合高翻桌率的高效動線，兼顧品牌個性與施工精度。

description.en: Meeting rooms, work areas and display niches form the Guochan Building Materials headquarters office. Wood, stone and indirect lighting give the interiors depth and definition.
description.zh: 以會議空間、辦公區與展示壁龕呈現國產建材總部辦公環境，透過木質、石材與間接照明展現空間層次。

description.en: Living room, bedroom and bathroom settings demonstrate building material applications, showing combinations of surfaces, edge details and lighting.
description.zh: 以客廳、臥室與衛浴等居家情境呈現建材應用，記錄不同材質、收邊與照明的搭配。

description.en: Glass partitions, timber walls and planting define the reception and meeting spaces, connecting discussion, waiting and conference areas.
description.zh: 接待與會議空間以玻璃隔間、木質牆面及植栽形成層次，串聯洽談、等候與會議區域。

description.en: Longteng Travel's office combines a stone reception area, discussion seating and planting to connect customer service with the internal workspace.
description.zh: 龍騰旅行社辦公空間以石材接待區、洽談座位及植栽配置，串聯對客服務與內部工作區域。

description.en: The TransAsia Bakery Dayuan store combines bakery retail, a service counter and seating. Aviation references and a blue-and-white palette shape the branded interior.
description.zh: 復興航棧大園店結合烘焙零售、櫃檯與休憩座位，透過航空意象及藍白色調呈現品牌空間。

description.en: Bakery display counters connect the entrance and dining seats at the TransAsia Bakery Chunri store, bringing retail and seating areas together.
description.zh: 復興航棧春日店以烘焙展示櫃連結店面入口與用餐座位，呈現品牌零售及休憩空間。

description.en: Brick walls, timber and continuous lighting shape the dining atmosphere, with a range of table settings, seats and circulation routes.
description.zh: 餐飲空間以磚牆、木質與連續照明形成用餐氛圍，呈現不同桌型、座位與通道的安排。

description.en: A metal counter, timber walls and pendant lights define the Burger-Ray interior, framing the ordering, preparation and seating areas.
description.zh: Burger-Ray 以金屬櫃檯、木質牆面與吊燈構成鮮明的餐飲空間，呈現點餐、備餐與座位區域。
